data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred in prior underwriting year 11,732 (268) 12,000

named_events.event_name: Collapse of the global oil price
named_events.loss_description: Led to lower sums insured and a decline in shipments affecting cargo; sharp decline in the number of offshore platforms and workforce impacting offshore energy exposures.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were $40.081m. During 2015 there was adverse prior-year development: gross 'claims incurred in prior underwriting year' of $11.732m (an adverse movement equal to ~29.3% of opening gross reserves), producing a net increase in gross claims outstanding to $43.851m at year end. The report attributes reserve risk to complex claims development and large/major losses; underwriting commentary highlights market and sector stress (notably the 2015 collapse in the global oil price) which affected Marine (cargo) and Energy exposures and is consistent with the observed adverse prior-year development.
raw_causal_phrases: the collapse of the global oil price during 2015
much lower sums insured coupled with a decline in the number of shipments
the decline in energy prices led to a sharp decline in the number of platforms still in production which meant less exploration
claims which are of a complex nature, particularly where information is not forthcoming or have the potential to develop further in the light of litigation or legal dispute
future advices/notifications particularly with respect to significant losses occurring close to the year end

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures reported in the native report currency (USD) and expressed in millions. The prior year development figure is taken from the claims outstanding reconciliation (Note 12) row 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year' (gross = $11,732k). There is no single running-text sentence explicitly summarising the gross prior year movement; the numeric movement is extracted from the Note 12 table. Field names include '_gbp_m' but amounts are reported in the report's currency (USD) as required.
